evidence.reason: The driver validates the phase only against the set of any PARTIAL_ORDER-derived phases, then chooses the activation versus restore handler solely from args.case. It never checks that the case embedded in the phase matches the supplied --case. A mismatched pair therefore reaches the wrong handler and writes output under args.phase, leaving state that can block the properly named phase. Rejecting the mismatch before either handler is a routine input-validation fix.
